evidence_level: OpenFAST/low-order one-sided static pitch end-state sweep

scope.purpose: compare final pitch increments under the same frozen-axis pitch moment and identify where the frozen small-angle low-order reading departs from OpenFAST
scope.environment: AeroDyn, InflowWind, ServoDyn, waves, and current disabled; HydroDyn and MoorDyn retained
scope.load_definition: HydroDyn AddF0 static preload at the WAMIT/OpenFAST reference point, obtained by rotating a pure frozen-axis pitch moment
scope.readout_definition: matched zero-preload original-damping release tail mean
scope.stability_definition: original-damping release tail range and consecutive-tail mean drift only
scope.loading_path_boundary: HydroDyn AddF0 is a static input. This endpoint comparison does not represent a time-continuous load ramp or a path-dependent mooring response.
